name: Are there specific building codes for bathroom windows in cities like San Francisco or Daly City?

mainEntity.name: Are there specific building codes for bathroom windows in cities like San Francisco or Daly City?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, local building codes in areas like San Francisco and Daly City often have specific requirements for bathroom windows, particularly concerning safety glazing and ventilation. For instance, windows in shower or tub enclosures typically require tempered safety glass. There may also be requirements for the size and type of operable window for adequate ventilation, or the use of exhaust fans if ventilation through a window isn't sufficient. It's crucial to work with a contractor familiar with current local codes to ensure your window replacement project is compliant.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, cities like San Francisco and Daly City have specific building codes for bathroom windows, often requiring tempered safety glass and adequate ventilation. A local contractor can ensure compliance.
